matsumoto-castle.name: Matsumoto Castle
matsumoto-castle.approx_cost: ¥1,300 adults with a paper ticket at the castle, ¥1,200 with an online e-ticket; elementary and junior-high students ¥400 (e-ticket). Older guides list ¥700.
